nodes.label: Decision Log — WorkflowHub Execution Flow Repair (2026-08-18)
Original Requirements R-001..R-007 (user verbatim)
nodes.rationale: User-visible defects drove the whole task: wrong make-decision ordering, one-question-at-a-time Talk, no real Grill/Clarify interaction, non-build-code review should be one heterologous round per stage, build-plan must design each phase's tasks and evidence.

nodes.label: D-008 — One public request per provider with blind direction review
nodes.rationale: The old runner fired two public requests (reconstruct + challenge) per direction review, which inflated cost and Kimi timeout risk; keeping the blind constraint inside a single request preserves one heterologous findings fact.

nodes.label: D-010 — No fixed provider total deadline; health-based lifecycle only
nodes.rationale: A fixed wall-clock total deadline kills healthy sessions that keep producing progress (the Kimi 360000ms PROCESS_TIMEOUT mis-kill), so lifecycle is governed by session health plus a 15-minute verified-no-progress stall instead of a total time cap.

nodes.label: D-011 — All dispatched providers terminal first, then minimum_heterologous=1 gate
nodes.rationale: Waiting for every dispatched member to reach completed/failed/cancelled avoids racing downstream against still-running providers; a parse-valid findings:[] counts as a result for threshold purposes but never as pass/quality completion.

nodes.label: D-012 — One-success-first preflight; no automatic retry or extra review
nodes.rationale: Wasted provider calls and tokens came from WorkflowHub's own material-contract errors and lifecycle misjudgement, so all track-specific material/route/group preflight must complete before dispatch and only one public group request is issued; real provider failures are still preserved, not retried.

nodes.label: G-012 — 15-minute health-based no-progress boundary marks unavailable
nodes.rationale: New progress/cursor/session changes reset the watchdog, so this is a stall detector rather than a total time limit and does not apply directly to unverifiable probes.

nodes.label: G-017 — Group terminal gate before threshold-based downstream handoff
nodes.rationale: Explicitly rejects early handoff when one provider finishes; the group waits for all dispatched members with no total time limit, closing out via G-012/G-013.

nodes.label: Provider identity — WorkflowHub profile key as route identity (D-004, F-003, OPEN-002)
nodes.rationale: Missing external raw source_id was wrongly used as a second dispatch gate (pi/k3 blocked pre-dispatch); dispatch identity is now the WorkflowHub profile key while the broker result still must expose verifiable identity. Stage-scoped route matrix: make-decision.direction=kimi/coding,codex/luna; detail adds opencode/v4flash; build-plan=pi/k3,opencode/v4flash,codex/luna; terra disabled and removed.

nodes.label: F-013/F-008 — Hard deadline chain killed healthy Kimi sessions (root cause)
nodes.rationale: Config deadline_ms=360000 was passed to process.execute maxDurationMs and the watchdog checked total elapsed before idle progress, so a session with 13653 progress events and a live process was still failed at 360153ms; the process was healthy, only the time limit was wrong.

nodes.label: PROCESS_STALLED — health-based stall error code (G-014/G-015)
nodes.rationale: The public error semantics must match the lifecycle fact, so an existing semantic path (PROCESS_STALLED) is reused instead of introducing a new code family or disguising the stall as PROCESS_TIMEOUT.

nodes.label: ATTACHMENT_DELIVERY_UNSUPPORTED repair — negotiated group attachment mode
nodes.rationale: The provider client inferred one group-wide always_embed mode from the presence of Codex, so file_only providers (Kimi, Antigravity) were contractually rejected at dispatch; the fix delegates per-provider choice to the broker's negotiated mode without splitting the group or reducing heterogeneity.

nodes.label: Stage Agent host boundary — outcome becomes optional execution fact
nodes.rationale: runOfficialStage() unconditionally required receipts.stage_outcomes and threw MATERIAL_INCOMPLETE without an external host, conflating execution facts with permission to proceed; per F3/Q1/Q2 the four current materials drive work, so a missing host is recorded as unavailable while the same task continues.

nodes.label: Final user confirmation (accepted, 2026-08-18T06:11:03.872Z)
nodes.rationale: User reply bound the extra constraint that no stage may trade review, test, interaction or evidence quality for speed, and must not violate the WorkflowHub constitution.
